encoding: unmodified public 1D scalar API, C=1, velocity in m/s, endpoints included; no geometry/forcing/BC tokens or output correction
precision: FD float64 and float32 CPU; OmniArch default CUDA bfloat16 autocast and CPU float32 diagnostic
interpretation: No superiority is assumed. Steady preservation is not a boundary-value solve. Parameter cases share normalized shapes and are not independent generalization evidence. Primary classical steady baseline solves the requested BVP; fair history forecasting comparison uses Crank-Nicolson and persistence with identical history.
